name: Entrance hall & staircase

dimensions.notes: Scaled from the 1:50 survey — approx. ±10 cm. Ceiling height as surveyed. The staircase rises as a dog-leg on the right side of the house through all floors — painting it is one continuous job (approx. 12 m of stairwell height).

orientation: Arched stone-framed front door to the street (1.19 m wide)

current.summary: Narrow hall behind the arched front door (house no. 2) with the stair rising straight ahead. The stair turns at each level, with a small window on the angled side wall at first and second floor landings.
keep: Arched stone door surround and fanlight grille (façade)

proposal.summary: Sewer connection passes under the entrance threshold to Largo Pietra Rossa.
